why: The named, shrink-only record of every check `make verify` is allowed to record as SKIP (rc 2 CANNOT-ASSESS) -- scripts/verify.sh's skip ratchet (issue #1199). A skip is named here or the run is REFUSED by name: the composite will not publish a `verify: PASS` whose skip set is narrated by nobody. Two kinds, both precise: `venue` (the check cannot assess because a NAMED PRECONDITION path of this venue is absent -- honoured only while that path is absent, so it de-activates itself the moment the venue supplies it; a check that still cannot assess WITH its precondition present is a defect of the CHECK, #1176, and is refused by name) and `standing-gap` (the check's inputs ARE present and it still cannot assess, so it must name the OPEN issue that tracks it and is STALE the moment it assesses -- the entry must then be deleted). An entry that matters is matched EXACTLY (check + kind + the precondition path or the issue), so it cannot widen to cover a different blindness.
empty-because-measured: The list is EMPTY at landing, and that is a measurement, not an omission. In the two venues this repository produces, NOTHING skips: (a) a FRESH WORKTREE (`git worktree add` of this repo) was run end to end -- 202 checks rc 0, 1 check rc 1 (an unrelated `reconcile` real-tree drift baseline), 0 checks rc 2, verdict `verify: FAIL (1 of 203 checks failed)` with NO `skipped:` clause at all; (b) the populated checkout of the same commit. A skip that appears is therefore a FINDING, not a known limit, and the ratchet refuses it by name with the remedy printed beside it -- which is the property this issue asked for: a skip bucket that cannot be permanently populated.

The two checks that used to occupy the bucket are NOT here because they were REPAIRED, not because they were excused: `dispatch-queue` (#1189) and `paperclip-routines` (#1176) both reach real verdicts (measured at origin/master a60ab88: rc 0 each, 9 and 11 controls provoked). Naming them would be the fiction this ratchet exists to prevent.

The `venue` KIND is not hypothetical and was measured too: in a tree carrying no local submodule objects (so `git submodule update --init vendor/CMR` cannot succeed offline), `module-registry`, `diagrams-declaration` and `codeidx-surface` each answer rc 2 -- `the pinned hub catalog is absent` / `vendored contract unreadable` / `vendored mandatory seed unreadable` -- exactly as each check's own header declares. A lane in that venue names them with the precondition path it is missing, or supplies the submodule; it does not get a silent PASS.

Growing this list is a deliberate act naming an OPEN issue (for a standing gap) or the precondition path (for a venue limit); shrinking it is automatic -- an entry whose check assesses FAILS the run until the entry is deleted.
